title: Conjuntos causales: fluctuations of the Benincasa-Dowker action and Everpresent Lambda
description: Code, saved results and test suite for the paper 'Non-Poissonian fluctuations of the Benincasa-Dowker action and the fate of Everpresent Lambda'. Poisson sprinkling of causal sets, exact finite-density means, the Moradi-Yazdi-Zilhão variance formalism for the local and smeared Benincasa-Dowker action, and fits of stochastic Lambda(t) histories to Pantheon+SH0ES, DESI DR2 BAO and Planck distance priors.
